subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add token-pressure-based automatic session rollover with durable handoff, and should it be separate from or folded into the broader session TTL/max-turn rotation design?
rationale: The requested behavior adds compatibility-sensitive public session config and changes routing and state-continuity semantics for long-running sessions.

options.title: Design one opt-in core lifecycle policy
options.body: Define token-pressure rollover, durable handoff, delivery identity preservation, and config/docs/tests in one maintainer-approved session lifecycle design.

options.title: Fold into session TTL work
options.body: Keep this as a requirement of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45390 so age, turn, and token-pressure rotation share one policy surface.

options.title: Defer automatic rollover
options.body: Keep existing compaction/manual reset mitigations and document that operators must handle proactive rotation outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Design one opt-in core lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Define token-pressure rollover, durable handoff, delivery identity preservation, and config/docs/tests in one maintainer-approved session lifecycle design.

likelyOwner.reason: The central session and compaction history points to steipete as the best available owner for the cross-boundary product decision.
